sceneConcept: A sturdy forty-year-old Chinese branch officer stands alone against a transparent background. Short black hair greys slightly at the temples, light stubble frames a practical square face, and a shallow scar lies beneath his left cheekbone. He wears a plain faded brown bomber jacket open over a charcoal t-shirt, dark work jeans, a simple belt and worn work boots. Both hands rest in his jacket pockets, and his posture is broad but restrained rather than threatening. Soft even frontal studio light keeps him grounded and unshowy. Visual refresh: a restrained red jacket with the white-tiger hall embroidery visible only at one rolled cuff.
naturalLanguageDetail: A sturdy broad-shouldered forty-year-old Chinese man with short black hair greying at the temples, light stubble and a shallow scar beneath his left cheekbone stands with both hands in the pockets of a plain faded brown bomber jacket over a charcoal t-shirt, dark work jeans and worn boots under soft even frontal studio light; a restrained red jacket with the white-tiger hall embroidery visible only at one rolled cuff; the portrait is framed from head to mid-thigh in a strict cowboy shot, with lower legs and feet outside the image.
